name: Live TV Channel Groups
description: Group Live TV channels by keyword (e.g. Hockey, NFL, News) as Tags and, optionally, Collections.
overview: Group Live TV channels by keyword
changelog: 1.2.1.0 - The program lookahead setting is now in days (default 7) instead of hours; existing hour values are converted automatically. 1.2.0.0 - Per-group match preview panel on the config page; the program-matching option now shows the current lookahead window. 1.1.0.0 - Groups can optionally match upcoming guide program names as well as channel names, with a configurable lookahead window (default 168 hours).
